<?php

final class Doc
{
    public bool $forced = false;
    public ?string $mode = null;

    public function __construct(
        public string $kind,
        public string $value = '',
        public array $items = [],
        public ?Doc $child = null,
        public int $amount = 0,
        public string $flat = '',
    ) {}
}

function mark(string $kind): Doc
{
    return new Doc($kind);
}

function suffix(string $value): Doc
{
    return new Doc('suffix', $value);
}

function ifBreak(string $broken, string $flat): Doc
{
    return new Doc('if_break', $broken, flat: $flat);
}

function concat(mixed ...$parts): Doc
{
    $items = [];
    $add = function (mixed $p) use (&$add, &$items): void {
        if ($p === null)
            return;
        if (is_array($p)) {
            foreach ($p as $x)
                $add($x);
            return;
        }
        if (is_string($p))
            $p = new Doc('text', $p);
        if ($p->kind === 'concat') {
            foreach ($p->items as $x)
                $add($x);
        } elseif ($p->kind === 'text') {
            if ($p->value === '')
                return;
            $last = count($items) - 1;
            if ($last >= 0 && $items[$last]->kind === 'text')
                $items[$last] = new Doc('text', $items[$last]->value . $p->value);
            else
                $items[] = new Doc('text', $p->value);
        } else
            $items[] = $p;
    };
    foreach ($parts as $part)
        $add($part);
    return match (count($items)) {
        0 => new Doc('text'),
        1 => $items[0],
        default => new Doc('concat', items: $items),
    };
}

function forceBroken(Doc $d): bool
{
    if (in_array($d->kind, ['hardline', 'break_parent'], true))
        return true;
    if ($d->kind === 'concat')
        return array_any($d->items, forceBroken(...));
    return $d->child !== null && forceBroken($d->child);
}

function group(mixed $child): Doc
{
    $d = new Doc('group', child: concat($child));
    $d->forced = forceBroken($d->child);
    return $d;
}

function nest(int $amount, mixed $child): Doc
{
    return new Doc('nest', child: concat($child), amount: $amount);
}

function align(mixed $child): Doc
{
    return new Doc('align', child: concat($child));
}

function allGroups(?Doc $d): Generator
{
    if ($d === null)
        return;
    if ($d->kind === 'group')
        yield $d;
    if ($d->child !== null)
        yield from allGroups($d->child);
    foreach ($d->items as $child)
        yield from allGroups($child);
}

<?php

const KEYWORDS = [
    'int',
    'float',
    'bool',
    'string',
    'void',
    'if',
    'else',
    'while',
    'for',
    'return',
    'break',
    'continue',
    'true',
    'false',
    'switch',
    'case',
    'default',
];

const TYPES = ['int', 'float', 'bool', 'string', 'void'];

const DOUBLE_SYMBOLS = ['<=', '>=', '==', '!=', '&&', '||', '+=', '-=', '*=', '/=', '%='];

const ASSIGNMENTS = ['=', '+=', '-=', '*=', '/=', '%='];

final class SourceError extends RuntimeException
{
    public function __construct(
        public int $sourceLine,
        public int $column,
        string $message,
    ) {
        parent::__construct($message);
    }
}

final class SourceToken
{
    public array $leading = [], $trailing = [];
    public bool $allowed = false, $trailingComma = false, $ownLine = false;

    public function __construct(
        public string $kind,
        public string $text,
        public int $line,
        public int $column,
        public int $blank,
        public int $index = -1,
    ) {}

    public function isComment(): bool
    {
        return $this->kind === 'line_comment' || $this->kind === 'block_comment';
    }
}

function lexicalAnalysis(array $lines): array
{
    $tokens = $comments = $items = [];
    $previous = 0;
    foreach ($lines as $li => $line) {
        $n = strlen($line);
        $i = 0;
        while ($i < $n) {
            $ch = $line[$i];
            if ($ch === ' ') {
                ++$i;
                continue;
            }
            $start = $i;
            $pair = substr($line, $i, 2);
            if ($pair === '//') {
                $kind = 'line_comment';
                $text = rtrim(substr($line, $i), ' ');
                $i = $n;
            } elseif ($pair === '/*') {
                $end = strpos($line, '*/', $i + 2);
                if ($end === false)
                    throw new SourceError($li + 1, $i + 1, 'unterminated comment');
                $i = $end + 2;
                $kind = 'block_comment';
                $text = substr($line, $start, $i - $start);
            } elseif (ctype_alpha($ch) || $ch === '_') {
                ++$i;
                while ($i < $n && (ctype_alnum($line[$i]) || $line[$i] === '_'))
                    ++$i;
                $text = substr($line, $start, $i - $start);
                $kind = in_array($text, KEYWORDS, true) ? 'keyword' : 'identifier';
            } elseif (ctype_digit($ch)) {
                ++$i;
                while ($i < $n && ctype_digit($line[$i]))
                    ++$i;
                if (($i + 1) < $n && $line[$i] === '.' && ctype_digit($line[$i + 1])) {
                    $i += 2;
                    while ($i < $n && ctype_digit($line[$i]))
                        ++$i;
                }
                $text = substr($line, $start, $i - $start);
                $kind = 'number';
            } elseif ($ch === '"') {
                ++$i;
                $closed = false;
                while ($i < $n) {
                    if ($line[$i] === '\\')
                        $i += 2;
                    elseif ($line[$i] === '"') {
                        ++$i;
                        $closed = true;
                        break;
                    } else
                        ++$i;
                }
                if (!$closed)
                    throw new SourceError($li + 1, $start + 1, 'unterminated string');
                $text = substr($line, $start, $i - $start);
                $kind = 'string';
            } elseif (in_array($pair, DOUBLE_SYMBOLS, true)) {
                $i += 2;
                $text = $pair;
                $kind = 'symbol';
            } elseif (str_contains('+-*/%<>=!()[]{},;.?:', $ch)) {
                ++$i;
                $text = $ch;
                $kind = 'symbol';
            } else
                throw new SourceError($li + 1, $start + 1, "unexpected character '$ch'");
            $t = new SourceToken($kind, $text, $li + 1, $start + 1, max(0, $li - $previous));
            $previous = $li + 1;
            $items[] = $t;
            if ($t->isComment())
                $comments[] = $t;
            else {
                $t->index = count($tokens);
                $tokens[] = $t;
            }
        }
    }
    $end = new SourceToken('end', '', count($lines) + 1, 1, 0, count($tokens));
    $end->allowed = true;
    $tokens[] = $end;
    return [$tokens, $comments, $items];
}

<?php

foreach (['lexer', 'parser', 'doc_builder', 'printer', 'report'] as $module)
    require_once __DIR__ . "/$module.php";
function attachComments(array $tokens, array $items): void
{
    $before = null;
    $after = [];
    $next = null;
    for ($i = count($items) - 1; $i >= 0; --$i) {
        $after[$i] = $next;
        if (!$items[$i]->isComment())
            $next = $items[$i];
    }
    foreach ($items as $i => $c) {
        if (!$c->isComment()) {
            $before = $c;
            continue;
        }
        $following = $items[$i + 1] ?? null;
        $n = $after[$i];
        $c->ownLine = $c->kind === 'line_comment' || $following === null || $following->line > $c->line;
        if ($before !== null && $before->line === $c->line && ($n === null || $n->line > $c->line))
            $before->trailing[] = $c;
        else {
            $target = $n ?? $tokens[count($tokens) - 1];
            $target->leading[] = $c;
        }
    }
}

function checkCommentPositions(array $tokens): void
{
    foreach ($tokens as $t)
        foreach ($t->leading as $c)
            if ($t->trailingComma || $c->ownLine && !$t->allowed)
                throw new SourceError($c->line, $c->column, 'comment not allowed here');
}

final class DocumentFormatter
{
    private int $indent, $maxBlank;
    private string $space, $keywordGap;
    private Doc $operatorBreak;
    private bool $kr;
    private array $originalTrailing;
    public ?Doc $firstFunctionDoc = null;
    public ?string $firstFunctionName = null;

    public function __construct(
        private array $profile,
        private array $tokens,
    ) {
        $this->indent = $profile['indent'];
        $this->maxBlank = $profile['max_blank_lines'];
        $this->space = $profile['space_around_operators'] ? ' ' : '';
        $this->operatorBreak = mark($profile['space_around_operators'] ? 'line' : 'softline');
        $this->keywordGap = $profile['space_after_keyword'] ? ' ' : '';
        $this->kr = $profile['brace_style'] === 'kr';
        $this->originalTrailing = array_map(fn($t) => (bool) $t->trailing, $tokens);
    }

    private function sep(int $blank): Doc
    {
        return concat(array_fill(0, 1 + min($blank, $this->maxBlank), mark('hardline')));
    }

    private function preBlank(SourceToken $t): int
    {
        return ($t->leading[0] ?? $t)->blank;
    }

    private function comments(array $comments, ?SourceToken $following): Doc
    {
        $parts = [];
        foreach ($comments as $i => $c) {
            $parts[] = $c->text;
            $next = $comments[$i + 1] ?? $following;
            if ($next !== null) {
                if ($c->ownLine)
                    $parts[] = $this->sep($next->blank);
                else
                    $parts[] = ' ';
            }
        }
        return concat($parts);
    }

    private function t(SourceToken $t, ?array $leading = null): Doc
    {
        return concat(
            $this->comments($leading ?? $t->leading, $t),
            $t->text,
            $t->trailing ? suffix(implode(' ', array_map(fn($c) => $c->text, $t->trailing))) : null,
        );
    }

    private function splitComments(SourceToken $t): array
    {
        $last = -1;
        foreach ($t->leading as $i => $c)
            if ($c->ownLine)
                $last = $i;
        return [array_slice($t->leading, 0, $last + 1), array_slice($t->leading, $last + 1)];
    }

    private function closingComments(array $comments, bool $preceding): ?Doc
    {
        return !$comments
            ? null
            : concat($preceding ? $this->sep($comments[0]->blank) : null, $this->comments($comments, null));
    }

    public function wholeFile(array $items, SourceToken $end): Doc
    {
        $parts = [];
        foreach ($items as $i => $item) {
            if ($i)
                $parts[] = $this->sep($this->preBlank($item->first));
            $d = $this->item($item);
            $parts[] = $d;
            if ($item->tag === 'function' && $this->firstFunctionDoc === null) {
                $this->firstFunctionDoc = $d;
                $this->firstFunctionName = $item->name->text;
            }
        }
        if ($end->leading) {
            if ($items)
                $parts[] = $this->sep($end->leading[0]->blank);
            $parts[] = $this->comments($end->leading, null);
        }
        return concat($parts);
    }

    private function item(object $e): Doc
    {
        return $e->tag === 'function'
            ? concat(
                $this->t($e->typ),
                ' ',
                $this->t($e->name),
                $this->listDoc($e->parameters),
                mark('hardline'),
                $this->block($e->body),
            )
            : $this->variable($e);
    }

    private function parameter(object $e): Doc
    {
        $parts = [$this->t($e->typ), ' ', $this->t($e->name)];
        foreach ($e->brackets as [$left, $right])
            array_push($parts, $this->t($left), $this->t($right));
        return concat($parts);
    }

    private function variable(object $e): Doc
    {
        $parts = [$this->t($e->typ), ' ', $this->t($e->name)];
        foreach ($e->dimensions as [$left, $expr, $right])
            array_push(
                $parts,
                $this->t($left),
                $expr === null ? null : $this->expr($expr, 0),
                $this->t($right),
            );
        if ($e->equals !== null)
            array_push(
                $parts,
                $this->space,
                $this->t($e->equals),
                $this->space,
                $this->initializer($e->initializer),
            );
        if ($e->semi !== null)
            $parts[] = $this->t($e->semi);
        return concat($parts);
    }

    private function initializer(object $e): Doc
    {
        return $e->tag === 'list' ? $this->listDoc($e) : $this->expr($e, 0);
    }

    private function listDoc(object $e): Doc
    {
        if (!$e->elements)
            return concat($this->t($e->left), $this->t($e->right));
        $forced = false;
        for ($i = $e->left->index; $i < $e->right->index; ++$i)
            if ($this->originalTrailing[$i]) {
                $forced = true;
                break;
            }
        $contents = [mark('softline')];
        foreach ($e->elements as $i => $item) {
            if ($i)
                array_push($contents, $this->t($e->commas[$i - 1]), mark('line'));
            $contents[] = $item->tag === 'parameter'
                ? $this->parameter($item)
                : ($e->role === '{' ? $this->initializer($item) : $this->expr($item, 0));
        }
        if ($e->role === '{') {
            $contents[] = ifBreak(',', '');
            if ($e->trailing !== null && $e->trailing->trailing)
                $contents[] = suffix(implode(' ', array_map(fn($c) => $c->text, $e->trailing->trailing)));
        }
        return group([
            $forced ? mark('break_parent') : null,
            $this->t($e->left),
            nest($this->indent, $contents),
            mark('softline'),
            $this->t($e->right),
        ]);
    }

    private function block(object $e): Doc
    {
        [$own, $inline] = $this->splitComments($e->right);
        if (!$e->statements && !$own)
            return concat($this->t($e->left), $this->t($e->right, $inline));
        $body = [mark('hardline')];
        foreach ($e->statements as $i => $s) {
            if ($i)
                $body[] = $this->sep($this->preBlank($s->first));
            $body[] = $this->statement($s);
        }
        $body[] = $this->closingComments($own, (bool) $e->statements);
        return concat(
            $this->t($e->left),
            nest($this->indent, $body),
            mark('hardline'),
            $this->t($e->right, $inline),
        );
    }

    private function body(object $e): Doc
    {
        $separator = $this->kr ? ' ' : mark('hardline');
        if ($e->tag === 'block')
            return concat($separator, $this->block($e));
        if ($this->profile['add_braces'])
            return concat($separator, '{', nest($this->indent, [
                mark('hardline'),
                $this->statement($e),
            ]), mark('hardline'), '}');
        return nest($this->indent, [mark('hardline'), $this->statement($e)]);
    }

    private function simple(object $e): Doc
    {
        return $e->tag === 'assign'
            ? concat(
                $this->expr($e->left, 0),
                $this->space,
                $this->t($e->op),
                $this->space,
                $this->expr($e->right, 0),
            )
            : $this->expr($e->expr, 0);
    }

    private function ifStatement(object $e): Doc
    {
        $parts = [
            $this->t($e->keyword),
            $this->keywordGap,
            $this->t($e->left),
            $this->expr($e->test, 0),
            $this->t($e->right),
            $this->body($e->body),
        ];
        if ($e->elseToken !== null) {
            $separator = $this->kr && ($e->body->tag === 'block' || $this->profile['add_braces'])
                ? ' '
                : mark('hardline');
            array_push($parts, $separator, $this->t($e->elseToken));
            if ($e->alternative->tag === 'if')
                array_push($parts, ' ', $this->ifStatement($e->alternative));
            else
                $parts[] = $this->body($e->alternative);
        }
        return concat($parts);
    }

    private function forStatement(object $e): Doc
    {
        $parts = [];
        if ($e->initial !== null)
            $parts[] = $e->initial->tag === 'variable'
                ? $this->variable($e->initial)
                : $this->simple($e->initial);
        $parts[] = $this->t($e->firstSemi);
        if ($e->condition !== null)
            array_push($parts, mark('line'), $this->expr($e->condition, 0));
        $parts[] = $this->t($e->secondSemi);
        if ($e->update !== null)
            array_push($parts, mark('line'), $this->simple($e->update));
        return concat(
            $this->t($e->keyword),
            $this->keywordGap,
            $this->t($e->left),
            group(align($parts)),
            $this->t($e->right),
            $this->body($e->body),
        );
    }

    private function clause(object $e): Doc
    {
        $parts = [$this->t($e->label)];
        if ($e->value !== null)
            array_push($parts, ' ', $this->expr($e->value, 0));
        $parts[] = $this->t($e->colon);
        if ($e->statements) {
            $body = [mark('hardline')];
            foreach ($e->statements as $i => $s) {
                if ($i)
                    $body[] = $this->sep($this->preBlank($s->first));
                $body[] = $this->statement($s);
            }
            $parts[] = nest($this->indent, $body);
        }
        return concat($parts);
    }

    private function switchStatement(object $e): Doc
    {
        [$own, $inline] = $this->splitComments($e->closing);
        $header = [
            $this->t($e->keyword),
            $this->keywordGap,
            $this->t($e->left),
            $this->expr($e->test, 0),
            $this->t($e->right),
            $this->kr ? ' ' : mark('hardline'),
            $this->t($e->opening),
        ];
        if (!$e->clauses && !$own)
            return concat($header, $this->t($e->closing, $inline));
        $body = [mark('hardline')];
        foreach ($e->clauses as $i => $c) {
            if ($i)
                $body[] = $this->sep($this->preBlank($c->label));
            $body[] = $this->clause($c);
        }
        $body[] = $this->closingComments($own, (bool) $e->clauses);
        return concat(
            $header,
            nest($this->profile['indent_case_labels'] ? $this->indent : 0, $body),
            mark('hardline'),
            $this->t($e->closing, $inline),
        );
    }

    private function statement(object $e): Doc
    {
        return match ($e->tag) {
            'block' => $this->block($e),
            'variable' => $this->variable($e),
            'simple_stmt' => concat($this->simple($e->value), $this->t($e->semi)),
            'return' => concat(
                $this->t($e->keyword),
                $e->expr === null ? null : [' ', $this->expr($e->expr, 0)],
                $this->t($e->semi),
            ),
            'flow' => concat($this->t($e->keyword), $this->t($e->semi)),
            'if' => $this->ifStatement($e),
            'for' => $this->forStatement($e),
            'switch' => $this->switchStatement($e),
            'while' => concat(
                $this->t($e->keyword),
                $this->keywordGap,
                $this->t($e->left),
                $this->expr($e->test, 0),
                $this->t($e->right),
                $this->body($e->body),
            ),
        };
    }

    private function lastToken(object $e): SourceToken
    {
        return match ($e->tag) {
            'primary' => $e->value,
            'paren', 'index' => $e->right,
            'unary' => $this->lastToken($e->operand),
            'binary' => $this->lastToken($e->right),
            'conditional' => $this->lastToken($e->no),
            'call' => $e->arguments->right,
            'member' => $e->member,
        };
    }

    private function opened(object $e, int $minimum): object
    {
        while ($this->profile['remove_parens'] && $e->tag === 'paren') {
            $inner = $e->inner;
            if (($inner->level ?? 8) < $minimum || $e->left->leading || $e->right->leading)
                break;
            $first = $inner->first;
            $last = $this->lastToken($inner);
            $first->trailing = [...$e->left->trailing, ...$first->trailing];
            $last->trailing = [...$last->trailing, ...$e->right->trailing];
            $e->left->trailing = $e->right->trailing = [];
            $e = $inner;
        }
        return $e;
    }

    private function binary(object $e): Doc
    {
        $p = $e->level;
        $ops = $operands = [];
        $x = $e;
        while ($x->tag === 'binary' && $x->level === $p) {
            $ops[] = $x->op;
            $operands[] = $x->right;
            $x = $this->opened($x->left, $p);
        }
        $ops = array_reverse($ops);
        $operands = array_reverse($operands);
        $parts = [];
        foreach ($ops as $i => $op)
            array_push(
                $parts,
                $this->operatorBreak,
                $this->t($op),
                $this->space,
                $this->expr($operands[$i], $p + 1),
            );
        return group([$this->expr($x, $p), nest($this->indent, $parts)]);
    }

    private function conditional(object $e): Doc
    {
        $parts = [];
        $x = $e;
        while (true) {
            array_push(
                $parts,
                $this->operatorBreak,
                $this->t($x->question),
                $this->space,
                $this->expr($x->yes, 0),
                $this->operatorBreak,
                $this->t($x->colon),
                $this->space,
            );
            $g = $this->opened($x->no, 0);
            if ($g->tag !== 'conditional') {
                $parts[] = $this->expr($g, 0);
                break;
            }
            $parts[] = $this->expr($g->test, 1);
            $x = $g;
        }
        return group([$this->expr($e->test, 1), nest($this->indent, $parts)]);
    }

    private function postfixPiece(object $e): Doc
    {
        return match ($e->tag) {
            'call' => $this->listDoc($e->arguments),
            'index' => concat($this->t($e->left), $this->expr($e->index, 0), $this->t($e->right)),
            'member' => concat($this->t($e->dot), $this->t($e->member)),
        };
    }

    private function postfix(object $e): Doc
    {
        $ops = [];
        $x = $e;
        while (in_array($x->tag, ['call', 'index', 'member'], true)) {
            $ops[] = $x;
            $x = $this->opened($x->target, 8);
        }
        $ops = array_reverse($ops);
        $segments = [[]];
        foreach ($ops as $op) {
            if ($op->tag === 'member')
                $segments[] = [];
            $segments[count($segments) - 1][] = $op;
        }
        $calls = [];
        foreach ($segments as $i => $segment)
            if ($i && array_any($segment, fn($op) => $op->tag === 'call'))
                $calls[] = $i;
        $head = $this->expr($x, 8);
        if (count($calls) < 2)
            return concat($head, array_map($this->postfixPiece(...), $ops));
        $before = $after = [];
        foreach ($segments as $i => $segment) {
            if ($i < $calls[0])
                array_push($before, ...array_map($this->postfixPiece(...), $segment));
            else
                array_push($after, mark('softline'), ...array_map($this->postfixPiece(...), $segment));
        }
        return group([$head, $before, nest($this->indent, $after)]);
    }

    private function expr(object $e, int $minimum): Doc
    {
        $e = $this->opened($e, $minimum);
        return match ($e->tag) {
            'primary' => $this->t($e->value),
            'paren' => concat($this->t($e->left), $this->expr($e->inner, 0), $this->t($e->right)),
            'unary' => concat($this->t($e->op), $this->expr($e->operand, 8)),
            'binary' => $this->binary($e),
            'conditional' => $this->conditional($e),
            default => $this->postfix($e),
        };
    }
}

function renderOnce(array $lines, array $profile): object
{
    [$tokens, $comments, $items] = lexicalAnalysis($lines);
    attachComments($tokens, $items);
    $syntax = new SourceParser($tokens)->parse();
    checkCommentPositions($tokens);
    $builder = new DocumentFormatter($profile, $tokens);
    $end = $tokens[count($tokens) - 1];
    if (!$syntax && !$end->leading)
        return (object) ['lines' => [], 'comments' => $comments, 'document' => null, 'builder' => $builder];
    $document = $builder->wholeFile($syntax, $end);
    return (object) [
        'lines' => layout($document, $profile),
        'comments' => $comments,
        'document' => $document,
        'builder' => $builder,
    ];
}

function main(): void
{
    $profiles = [];
    $current = '';
    foreach (file('input/style.txt', FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES) as $line) {
        if ($line === '')
            continue;
        if ($line[0] === '[') {
            $current = substr($line, 1, -1);
            $profiles[$current] = [];
        } else {
            [$key, $value] = explode('=', $line, 2);
            $profiles[$current][$key] = in_array(
                $key,
                ['width', 'indent', 'max_blank_lines', 'comment_column'],
                true,
            )
                ? (int) $value
                : ($value === 'yes' ? true : ($value === 'no' ? false : $value));
        }
    }
    $sources = [];
    foreach (file('input/sources.txt', FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES) as $line) {
        if (str_starts_with($line, '=== ')) {
            [, $name, $profile] = explode(' ', $line);
            $sources[] = (object) ['header' => $line, 'name' => $name, 'profile' => $profile, 'lines' => []];
        } else
            $sources[count($sources) - 1]->lines[] = $line;
    }
    $formatted = $idempotency = $diagnostics = $trees = $changes = [];
    foreach ($sources as $source) {
        $name = $source->name;
        $profile = $profiles[$source->profile];
        $original = array_map(fn($s) => rtrim($s, ' '), $source->lines);
        $formatted[] = $source->header;
        $trees[] = $changes[] = "=== $name";
        try {
            $first = renderOnce($source->lines, $profile);
        } catch (SourceError $e) {
            array_push($formatted, ...$original);
            $idempotency[] = "$name: skipped (syntax error)";
            $diagnostics[] = "$name:{$e->sourceLine}:{$e->column}: error: " . $e->getMessage();
            $trees[] = 'syntax error';
            $changes[] = 'skipped (syntax error)';
            continue;
        }
        array_push($formatted, ...$first->lines);
        try {
            $second = renderOnce($first->lines, $profile);
            if ($first->lines === $second->lines)
                $idempotency[] = "$name: stable";
            else {
                $difference = 0;
                $n = min(count($first->lines), count($second->lines));
                while ($difference < $n && $first->lines[$difference] === $second->lines[$difference])
                    ++$difference;
                $idempotency[] = "$name: unstable at line " . ($difference + 1);
            }
        } catch (SourceError $e) {
            $idempotency[] =
                "$name: unstable (second pass: {$e->sourceLine}:{$e->column}: " . $e->getMessage() . ')';
        }
        $longest = 0;
        foreach ($first->lines as $i => $line) {
            $length = strlen($line);
            $longest = max($longest, $length);
            if ($length > $profile['width'])
                $diagnostics[] =
                    "$name:" . ($i + 1) . ": warning: line too long ($length > {$profile['width']})";
        }
        $groups = iterator_to_array(allGroups($first->document), false);
        $broken = count(array_filter($groups, fn($g) => in_array($g->mode, ['break', 'forced'], true)));
        $forced = count(array_filter($groups, fn($g) => $g->mode === 'forced'));
        $trees[] =
            'metrics lines='
            . count($first->lines)
            . " longest=$longest comments="
            . count($first->comments)
            . ' groups='
            . count($groups)
            . " broken=$broken forced=$forced";
        if ($first->builder->firstFunctionDoc === null)
            $trees[] = 'no function';
        else {
            $trees[] = 'function ' . $first->builder->firstFunctionName;
            array_push($trees, ...docTree($first->builder->firstFunctionDoc));
        }
        array_push($changes, ...diffLines($original, $first->lines));
    }
    if (!$diagnostics)
        $diagnostics = ['no diagnostics'];
    if (!is_dir('output'))
        mkdir('output');
    foreach ([
        'formatted.txt' => $formatted,
        'idempotency.txt' => $idempotency,
        'diagnostics.txt' => $diagnostics,
        'doc_tree.txt' => $trees,
        'changes.txt' => $changes,
    ] as $name => $lines)
        file_put_contents('output/' . $name, implode("\n", $lines) . "\n");
}

main();

const PRECEDENCE = [
    '||' => 1,
    '&&' => 2,
    '==' => 3,
    '!=' => 3,
    '<' => 4,
    '<=' => 4,
    '>' => 4,
    '>=' => 4,
    '+' => 5,
    '-' => 5,
    '*' => 6,
    '/' => 6,
    '%' => 6,
];

function syntaxNode(string $tag, SourceToken $first, array $props = []): object
{
    return (object) (['tag' => $tag, 'first' => $first] + $props);
}

final class SourceParser
{
    private int $cursor = 0;

    public function __construct(
        private array $tokens,
    ) {}

    private function peek(): SourceToken
    {
        return $this->tokens[$this->cursor];
    }

    private function at(string $s): bool
    {
        return $this->peek()->text === $s;
    }

    private function fail(string $expected): never
    {
        $t = $this->peek();
        $actual = $t->kind === 'end' ? 'end of file' : "'{$t->text}'";
        throw new SourceError($t->line, $t->column, "expected $expected, found $actual");
    }

    private function take(string $s): SourceToken
    {
        if (!$this->at($s))
            $this->fail("'$s'");
        return $this->tokens[$this->cursor++];
    }

    private function identifier(): SourceToken
    {
        if ($this->peek()->kind !== 'identifier')
            $this->fail('identifier');
        return $this->tokens[$this->cursor++];
    }

    private function type(): SourceToken
    {
        if (!$this->isType())
            $this->fail('type');
        return $this->tokens[$this->cursor++];
    }

    private function isType(): bool
    {
        return in_array($this->peek()->text, TYPES, true);
    }

    public function parse(): array
    {
        $r = [];
        while ($this->peek()->kind !== 'end')
            $r[] = $this->item();
        return $r;
    }

    private function item(): object
    {
        $typ = $this->type();
        $typ->allowed = true;
        $name = $this->identifier();
        if ($this->at('(')) {
            $parameters = $this->listOf('(', ')', $this->parameter(...), false);
            $body = $this->block();
            return syntaxNode('function', $typ, compact('typ', 'name', 'parameters', 'body'));
        }
        return $this->variable($typ, $name, true);
    }

    private function parameter(): object
    {
        $typ = $this->type();
        $name = $this->identifier();
        $brackets = [];
        while ($this->at('['))
            $brackets[] = [$this->take('['), $this->take(']')];
        return syntaxNode('parameter', $typ, compact('typ', 'name', 'brackets'));
    }

    private function variable(SourceToken $typ, SourceToken $name, bool $semicolon): object
    {
        $dimensions = [];
        while ($this->at('[')) {
            $left = $this->take('[');
            $expr = $this->at(']') ? null : $this->expression();
            $right = $this->take(']');
            $dimensions[] = [$left, $expr, $right];
        }
        $equals = $this->at('=') ? $this->take('=') : null;
        $initializer = $equals === null ? null : $this->initializer();
        $semi = $semicolon ? $this->take(';') : null;
        return syntaxNode(
            'variable',
            $typ,
            compact('typ', 'name', 'dimensions', 'equals', 'initializer', 'semi'),
        );
    }

    private function initializer(): object
    {
        return $this->at('{') ? $this->listOf('{', '}', $this->initializer(...), true) : $this->expression();
    }

    private function listOf(string $opening, string $closing, callable $element, bool $allowTrailing): object
    {
        $left = $this->take($opening);
        $elements = $commas = [];
        $trailing = null;
        if (!$this->at($closing)) {
            $x = $element();
            $x->first->allowed = true;
            $elements[] = $x;
            while ($this->at(',')) {
                $c = $this->take(',');
                if ($allowTrailing && $this->at($closing)) {
                    $c->trailingComma = true;
                    $trailing = $c;
                    break;
                }
                $commas[] = $c;
                $x = $element();
                $x->first->allowed = true;
                $elements[] = $x;
            }
        }
        $right = $this->take($closing);
        return syntaxNode(
            'list',
            $left,
            compact('left', 'right', 'elements', 'commas', 'trailing') + ['role' => $opening],
        );
    }

    private function block(): object
    {
        $left = $this->take('{');
        $statements = [];
        while (!$this->at('}') && $this->peek()->kind !== 'end') {
            $s = $this->statement();
            $s->first->allowed = true;
            $statements[] = $s;
        }
        $right = $this->take('}');
        $right->allowed = true;
        return syntaxNode('block', $left, compact('left', 'right', 'statements'));
    }

    private function statement(): object
    {
        if ($this->at('{'))
            return $this->block();
        if ($this->isType()) {
            $typ = $this->type();
            return $this->variable($typ, $this->identifier(), true);
        }
        if ($this->at('if'))
            return $this->ifStatement();
        if ($this->at('while')) {
            $keyword = $this->take('while');
            $left = $this->take('(');
            $test = $this->expression();
            $right = $this->take(')');
            $body = $this->body();
            return syntaxNode('while', $keyword, compact('keyword', 'left', 'test', 'right', 'body'));
        }
        if ($this->at('for'))
            return $this->forStatement();
        if ($this->at('switch'))
            return $this->switchStatement();
        if ($this->at('return')) {
            $keyword = $this->take('return');
            $expr = $this->at(';') ? null : $this->expression();
            $semi = $this->take(';');
            return syntaxNode('return', $keyword, compact('keyword', 'expr', 'semi'));
        }
        if ($this->at('break') || $this->at('continue')) {
            $keyword = $this->tokens[$this->cursor++];
            $semi = $this->take(';');
            return syntaxNode('flow', $keyword, compact('keyword', 'semi'));
        }
        $value = $this->simple();
        $semi = $this->take(';');
        return syntaxNode('simple_stmt', $value->first, compact('value', 'semi'));
    }

    private function body(): object
    {
        $s = $this->statement();
        if ($s->tag !== 'block')
            $s->first->allowed = true;
        return $s;
    }

    private function ifStatement(): object
    {
        $keyword = $this->take('if');
        $left = $this->take('(');
        $test = $this->expression();
        $right = $this->take(')');
        $body = $this->body();
        $elseToken = $this->at('else') ? $this->take('else') : null;
        $alternative = null;
        if ($elseToken !== null) {
            if ($this->at('if'))
                $alternative = $this->ifStatement();
            else
                $alternative = $this->body();
        }
        return syntaxNode(
            'if',
            $keyword,
            compact('keyword', 'left', 'test', 'right', 'body', 'elseToken', 'alternative'),
        );
    }

    private function forStatement(): object
    {
        $keyword = $this->take('for');
        $left = $this->take('(');
        if ($this->at(';'))
            $initial = null;
        elseif ($this->isType()) {
            $typ = $this->type();
            $initial = $this->variable($typ, $this->identifier(), false);
        } else
            $initial = $this->simple();
        $firstSemi = $this->take(';');
        $condition = $this->at(';') ? null : $this->expression();
        $secondSemi = $this->take(';');
        $update = $this->at(')') ? null : $this->simple();
        $right = $this->take(')');
        $body = $this->body();
        return syntaxNode(
            'for',
            $keyword,
            compact(
                'keyword',
                'left',
                'initial',
                'firstSemi',
                'condition',
                'secondSemi',
                'update',
                'right',
                'body',
            ),
        );
    }

    private function switchStatement(): object
    {
        $keyword = $this->take('switch');
        $left = $this->take('(');
        $test = $this->expression();
        $right = $this->take(')');
        $opening = $this->take('{');
        $clauses = [];
        while ($this->at('case') || $this->at('default')) {
            $label = $this->tokens[$this->cursor++];
            $label->allowed = true;
            $value = $label->text === 'case' ? $this->expression() : null;
            $colon = $this->take(':');
            $statements = [];
            while (
                !in_array($this->peek()->text, ['case', 'default', '}'], true)
                && $this->peek()->kind !== 'end'
            ) {
                $s = $this->statement();
                $s->first->allowed = true;
                $statements[] = $s;
            }
            $clauses[] = syntaxNode('clause', $label, compact('label', 'value', 'colon', 'statements'));
        }
        $closing = $this->take('}');
        $closing->allowed = true;
        return syntaxNode(
            'switch',
            $keyword,
            compact('keyword', 'left', 'test', 'right', 'opening', 'closing', 'clauses'),
        );
    }

    private function simple(): object
    {
        $left = $this->expression();
        if (in_array($this->peek()->text, ASSIGNMENTS, true)) {
            $op = $this->tokens[$this->cursor++];
            $right = $this->expression();
            return syntaxNode('assign', $left->first, compact('left', 'op', 'right'));
        }
        return syntaxNode('expr_stmt', $left->first, ['expr' => $left]);
    }

    private function expression(): object
    {
        $test = $this->binary(1);
        if (!$this->at('?'))
            return $test;
        $question = $this->take('?');
        $yes = $this->expression();
        $colon = $this->take(':');
        $no = $this->expression();
        return syntaxNode(
            'conditional',
            $test->first,
            compact('test', 'question', 'yes', 'colon', 'no') + ['level' => 0],
        );
    }

    private function binary(int $p): object
    {
        if ($p > 6)
            return $this->unary();
        $left = $this->binary($p + 1);
        while ((PRECEDENCE[$this->peek()->text] ?? 0) === $p) {
            $op = $this->tokens[$this->cursor++];
            $right = $this->binary($p + 1);
            $left = syntaxNode('binary', $left->first, compact('left', 'op', 'right') + ['level' => $p]);
        }
        return $left;
    }

    private function unary(): object
    {
        if ($this->at('-') || $this->at('!')) {
            $op = $this->tokens[$this->cursor++];
            return syntaxNode('unary', $op, ['op' => $op, 'operand' => $this->unary(), 'level' => 7]);
        }
        $target = $this->primary();
        while (true) {
            if ($this->at('('))
                $target = syntaxNode('call', $target->first, [
                    'target' => $target,
                    'arguments' => $this->listOf('(', ')', $this->expression(...), false),
                    'level' => 8,
                ]);
            elseif ($this->at('[')) {
                $left = $this->take('[');
                $index = $this->expression();
                $right = $this->take(']');
                $target = syntaxNode(
                    'index',
                    $target->first,
                    compact('target', 'left', 'index', 'right') + ['level' => 8],
                );
            } elseif ($this->at('.')) {
                $dot = $this->take('.');
                $member = $this->identifier();
                $target = syntaxNode(
                    'member',
                    $target->first,
                    compact('target', 'dot', 'member') + ['level' => 8],
                );
            } else
                return $target;
        }
    }

    private function primary(): object
    {
        $t = $this->peek();
        if (
            in_array($t->kind, ['identifier', 'number', 'string'], true)
            || in_array($t->text, ['true', 'false'], true)
        ) {
            ++$this->cursor;
            return syntaxNode('primary', $t, ['value' => $t, 'level' => 8]);
        }
        if ($this->at('(')) {
            $left = $this->take('(');
            $inner = $this->expression();
            $right = $this->take(')');
            return syntaxNode('paren', $left, compact('left', 'inner', 'right') + ['level' => 8]);
        }
        $this->fail('expression');
    }
}

function fits(int $remaining, array $candidate, array $rest): bool
{
    if ($remaining < 0)
        return false;
    $check = [$candidate];
    $next = count($rest) - 1;
    while (true) {
        if (!$check) {
            if ($next < 0)
                return true;
            $check[] = $rest[$next--];
        }
        [$indent, $mode, $d] = array_pop($check);
        switch ($d->kind) {
            case 'text':
                $remaining -= strlen($d->value);
                break;
            case 'if_break':
                $remaining -= strlen($mode === 'break' ? $d->value : $d->flat);
                break;
            case 'line':
                if ($mode === 'break')
                    return true;
                --$remaining;
                break;
            case 'softline':
                if ($mode === 'break')
                    return true;
                break;
            case 'hardline':
                return true;
            case 'concat':
                foreach (array_reverse($d->items) as $child)
                    $check[] = [$indent, $mode, $child];
                break;
            case 'group':
                $check[] = [$indent, $d->forced ? 'break' : $mode, $d->child];
                break;
            case 'nest':
            case 'align':
                $check[] = [$indent, $mode, $d->child];
                break;
        }
        if ($remaining < 0)
            return false;
    }
}

function layout(Doc $document, array $profile): array
{
    $result = [];
    $current = '';
    $pending = [];
    $stack = [[0, 'break', $document]];
    $finalize = function () use (&$result, &$current, &$pending, $profile): void {
        $out = rtrim($current, ' ');
        if ($pending) {
            $s = implode(' ', $pending);
            $q = $profile['comment_column'];
            if ($q > 0 && strlen($out) < ($q - 1) && ($q - 1 + strlen($s)) <= $profile['width'])
                $out .= str_repeat(' ', $q - 1 - strlen($out)) . $s;
            else
                $out .= ' ' . $s;
            $pending = [];
        }
        $result[] = $out;
    };
    while ($stack) {
        [$i, $mode, $d] = array_pop($stack);
        switch ($d->kind) {
            case 'text':
                $current .= $d->value;
                break;
            case 'if_break':
                $current .= $mode === 'break' ? $d->value : $d->flat;
                break;
            case 'line':
            case 'softline':
                if ($mode === 'flat') {
                    if ($d->kind === 'line')
                        $current .= ' ';
                    break;
                }
            case 'hardline':
                $finalize();
                $current = str_repeat(' ', $i);
                break;
            case 'concat':
                foreach (array_reverse($d->items) as $child)
                    $stack[] = [$i, $mode, $child];
                break;
            case 'nest':
                $stack[] = [$i + $d->amount, $mode, $d->child];
                break;
            case 'align':
                $stack[] = [strlen($current), $mode, $d->child];
                break;
            case 'suffix':
                $pending[] = $d->value;
                break;
            case 'group':
                $d->mode = $mode === 'flat'
                    ? 'flat'
                    : (
                        $d->forced
                            ? 'forced'
                            : (
                                fits($profile['width'] - strlen($current), [$i, 'flat', $d->child], $stack)
                                    ? 'flat'
                                    : 'break'
                            )
                    );
                $stack[] = [$i, $d->mode === 'flat' ? 'flat' : 'break', $d->child];
                break;
        }
    }
    $finalize();
    return $result;
}

function docTree(Doc $d, int $depth = 0): array
{
    if ($d->kind === 'concat') {
        $out = [];
        foreach ($d->items as $child)
            array_push($out, ...docTree($child, $depth));
        return $out;
    }
    $prefix = str_repeat('  ', $depth);
    $line = match ($d->kind) {
        'text' => 'text "' . $d->value . '"',
        'suffix' => 'suffix "' . $d->value . '"',
        'if_break' => 'if_break "' . $d->value . '" "' . $d->flat . '"',
        'group' => 'group ' . $d->mode,
        'nest' => 'nest ' . $d->amount,
        default => $d->kind,
    };
    return [$prefix . $line, ...($d->child === null ? [] : docTree($d->child, $depth + 1))];
}

function diffLines(array $a, array $b): array
{
    $n = count($a);
    $m = count($b);
    $lcs = array_fill(0, $n + 1, array_fill(0, $m + 1, 0));
    for ($i = $n - 1; $i >= 0; --$i)
        for ($j = $m - 1; $j >= 0; --$j)
            $lcs[$i][$j] = $a[$i] === $b[$j]
                ? $lcs[$i + 1][$j + 1] + 1
                : max($lcs[$i + 1][$j], $lcs[$i][$j + 1]);
    $i = $j = $deleted = $inserted = 0;
    $hunks = [];
    $h = null;
    while ($i < $n || $j < $m) {
        if ($i < $n && $j < $m && $a[$i] === $b[$j]) {
            if ($h !== null) {
                $hunks[] = $h;
                $h = null;
            }
            ++$i;
            ++$j;
            continue;
        }
        if ($h === null)
            $h = (object) ['a' => $i, 'b' => $j, 'deletes' => 0, 'inserts' => 0, 'lines' => []];
        if ($j === $m || $i < $n && $lcs[$i + 1][$j] >= $lcs[$i][$j + 1]) {
            ++$h->deletes;
            ++$deleted;
            $h->lines[] = '-' . $a[$i++];
        } else {
            ++$h->inserts;
            ++$inserted;
            $h->lines[] = '+' . $b[$j++];
        }
    }
    if ($h !== null)
        $hunks[] = $h;
    $out = ['hunks=' . count($hunks) . " deleted=$deleted inserted=$inserted"];
    foreach ($hunks as $h) {
        $x = $h->a + ($h->deletes ? 1 : 0);
        $y = $h->b + ($h->inserts ? 1 : 0);
        $out[] = "@@ -$x,{$h->deletes} +$y,{$h->inserts} @@";
        array_push($out, ...$h->lines);
    }
    return $out;
}
